title: spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy are dead code — the reveals buffer latches the ambient allocator on first append and is never freed
detail: The View-owned reveals dynamic is never made with an explicit allocator nor deleted; the first append latches ambient context. Bounded (~192B) but tracker-flagged, and it dangles if feed ever runs under a per-frame arena.
recommended_fix: Wire spawn_fx_init at View setup and spawn_fx_destroy at teardown in app, harness, and tests — or delete the dead procs and document the ambient-allocator latch.

title: sfx_load_cat ignores its allocator param — catalog loads land on the tracked heap, adding 3,318 tracker leak lines (baseline 0)
detail: Every caller passes context.temp_allocator but the param is unused; reads and catalogs_load allocate via the ambient tracked heap. Core assumes arena-owned parse intermediates, never freed — tracker noise masks real regressions.
recommended_fix: Forward the allocator to read1's os.read_entire_file_from_path and to pp.catalogs_load; free the src slices with the same allocator (or drop the defers — the temp arena owns them).
